notes: Meridiem's official announcement explicitly separates the North American physical publishing handled by PM Studios from Meridiem's European Special Edition.
GameFAQs ties UPC 850080032398 specifically to the US physical Switch release. Bitjump independently labels the same barcode product North America.
PM-00234 is a commercial manufacturer/vendor part number corroborated by Vast, GameStop and active eBay metadata; it is not treated as a Nintendo cartridge serial.
No legible rear-package image or cartridge-label serial was found in this run, so packaging language, Nintendo media serial and box code remain unresolved.
This is a different physical product from the PM Studios North American Standard release and must not be merged with UPC 850080032398.
Meridiem officially describes its release as a European physical Special Edition; GameFAQs and multiple exact-EAN retailer records corroborate barcode 8436622260775.

World of Games explicitly labels packaging as English/French/Italian. Because this packaging-language detail was found in one specialist metadata source only, that field is kept probable rather than confirmed.

This result documents the related release because the order requires all physical regional releases, but it does not claim coverage of the separately queued catalog:switch-drive-rally-special-edition entry or prove a Spain-specific package variant.
